name: date-picker
title: Date picker
description: A button that opens a calendar and shows the chosen date.
a11y: The trigger is a button naming the field and the current value; it opens a dialog with the calendar.
Choosing a date closes the dialog and returns focus to the trigger; Escape closes without changing.
All calendar keyboard behaviour applies inside.
With `clearable`, a "Clear date" button in the popover removes the date, closes it and returns focus to the trigger.
